risks.risk: Whether it is a complete table or just the top (legs/stand missing).
risks.proof: Ask for photos showing the full item from multiple angles, including the underside and any leg/stand parts (if any).

risks.risk: Hidden damage: chips, hairline cracks, or edge damage not visible from one angle.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video moving the glass under light from all sides, especially the edges and corners.

risks.risk: Size/dimensions unknown; pricing depends heavily on length/width and thickness.
risks.proof: Ask for a tape-measure photo showing length, width, and glass thickness (or at least length x width).
